questions.question: A person deposits Rs. 8,000 in a bank which pays 8% p.a. simple interest. The amount after 8 years will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P = Rs. 8,000

SI = 8%

T = 8 years

**Formula:**

SI = (P × r × t)/100

where P → Principal

r → rate of interest

t → time period

Amount = S.I. + P

**Calculation:**

SI = (8000 × 8 × 8)/100 

⇒ SI = 5120

∴ A = P + SI = 8,000 + 5120 = 13,120

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let P = 100% 

then interest for 8 years = 8 + 8 =64 %

So, Amount = 100 + 64% = 164%

⇒ 100% = 8000

⇒ 164% = (8000/100) × 164 = Rs. 13120

questions.question: When an integer n is divided by 5, the remainder is 3. What is the remainder if 8n is divided by 5?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

When an integer n is divided by 5, the remainder is 3.

**Formula:**

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder 

**Calculation:**

Let quotient be q, then

n = 5q + 3

Multiply by 8 in equation (1)

⇒ 8n = 40q + 24

⇒ 8n = 40q + 20 + 4

⇒ 8n = 5 × (8q + 4) + 4

∴ Now we can say remainder is 4.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bd67c9563cdde4a0dfe99b7686282bc07365f691adfb64c907de66aebe4b011.png] **__

Let n be 8. [Satisfied the given condition]

Now, 8n = 8 × 8 = 64

When we divide 64 by 5, we will have 4 as the remainder.

questions.question: If sin x=(12)/(37), then what is the value of tan x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sin x = 12/37

**Formula:**

(Hypotenuse)² = (Base)² + (Perpendicular)²

sin x = P/H

tan x = P/B

where, Hypotenuse = H, Base = B and Perpendicular = P

**Calculation:**

sin x = 12/37

⇒ P/H = 12/37

Hence, P = 12 and H = 37

Now,

37² = 12² + B²

⇒ 1369 = 144 + B²

⇒ B² = 1369 - 144

⇒ B = √1225

⇒ B = 35

∴ tan x = 12/35

questions.question: If 2x + y = 6 and xy = 4, then find the value of 8x³ + y³ is:
questions.solution:
Given:

2x + y = 6

xy = 4

Formula:

(x + y)2 = x2 + y2 + 2xy

x3 + y3 = (x + y) (x² + y2 - xy)

Calculation:

2x + y = 6

xy = 4

⇒ (2x + y)2 = 4x2 + y2 + 4xy

⇒ 62 = 4x² + y² + 4 × 4

⇒ 4x² + y² = 36 - 16

⇒ 4x² + y² = 20

Now,

(2x)3 + y3 = (2x + y) (4x² + y2 - 2xy)

⇒ 8x3 + y3 = 6 (20 - 2 × 4)

⇒ 8x3 + y3 = 6 × (20 - 8)

⇒ 8x3 + y3 = 6 × 12

∴ 8x3 + y3 = 72

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

2x + y = 6

xy = 4

Put x = 1 and y = 4, then condition is satisfied.

8x3 + y3

⇒ 8 × 13 + 43

⇒ 8 + 64

⇒ 72

questions.question: What is the radius of the circle whose area is equal to the sum of the areas of two circles whose radii are 15 cm and 8 cm?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the area of a new circle is equal to the sum of the areas of two circles with radii r₁ and r₂, the radius R of the new circle is simply given by the Pythagorean relation: R = √(r₁² + r₂²).

Given, r₁ = 15 cm and r₂ = 8 cm.

R = √(15² + 8²)

R = √(225 + 64) = √289

R = 17 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 17 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the first circle (r₁) = 15 cm

Radius of the second circle (r₂) = 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of a circle = πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31d8601146b39737836c99c6d354e8950736f25d38ee5da5e4c668addd45cdf5.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the radius of the larger circle be R.

⇒ Area of new circle = Area of first circle + Area of second circle

⇒ πR² = π(r₁)² + π(r₂)²

⇒ πR² = π × (15² + 8²)

⇒ R² = 225 + 64

⇒ R² = 289

⇒ R = √289

⇒ R = 17 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 17 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Triplets

Three positive integers a, b, and c that satisfy a² + b² = c² form a Pythagorean triplet. Common examples are (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), and (7, 24, 25). Spotting these saves calculation time.

Circumference Sum Relation

If the circumference of a circle equals the sum of the circumferences of two circles with radii r₁ and r₂, then the radius R of the new circle follows a direct linear addition: R = r₁ + r₂.

Area of Semicircle and Quadrant

Area of a Semicircle = ½ πr² and its Perimeter = πr + 2r. Area of a Quadrant = ¼ πr² and its Perimeter = πr/2 + 2r.
</p

questions.question: The lengths of the two sides forming the right angle of a right-angled triangle are 21 cm and 20 cm. What is the radius of the circle circumscribing the triangle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The lengths of the two sides forming the right angle of a right-angled triangle are 21 cm and 20 cm

**Formula:**

Hypotenuse² = Base² + Perpendicular²

Circum-radius of the right-angled triangle = Hypotenuse/2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0e0d3b347f3189e2a318dc58f3746b212ef4ab6366d0c537070bcfe69441c00.png] 

**Calculation:**

Base = 21 cm and Perpendicular = 20 cm

⇒ (Hypotenuse)² = 21² + 20²

⇒ 441 + 400

⇒ 841

⇒ (Hypotenuse) = √841 = 29

∴ Circum-radius of the right-angled triangle = 29/2 = 14.5 cm

questions.question: If the three sides of a triangle are 11 cm, 12 cm and 13 cm, then what is the area of the given triangle (in cm²)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a triangle with sides **11 cm**, **12 cm**, and **13 cm**:

Calculate **Semi-perimeter (s)** = (11 + 12 + 13) ÷ 2 = 18 cm.

Apply **Heron's Formula**: Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)]

Area = √[18 × (18 − 11) × (18 − 12) × (18 − 13)] = √[18 × 7 × 6 × 5]

Area = √[3780] = 6√105 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 6√105 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the triangle: **a = 11 cm**, **b = 12 cm**, **c = 13 cm**.

**Formula Used:**

Semi-perimeter (s) = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

Area of triangle = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c9c175a17274e2337da394b358f8bbc750e626b1446d008cfd46ac15d7ff911.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ s = (11 + 12 + 13) ÷ 2

⇒ s = 36 ÷ 2 = 18 cm

⇒ Area = √[18 × (18 − 11) × (18 − 12) × (18 − 13)]

⇒ Area = √[18 × 7 × 6 × 5]

⇒ Area = √[3 × 6 × 7 × 6 × 5]

⇒ Area = 6 × √[3 × 7 × 5]

⇒ Area = 6√105 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 6√105 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

Used to find the area of a **scalene triangle** when all three sides are known: Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)].

Equilateral Triangle Area

If all sides are equal to 'a', the area is given by (√3 ÷ 4) × a².

Right-Angled Triangle

Area = (1 ÷ 2) × Base × Height. Also, Pythagoras theorem applies: a² + b² = c².</p

questions.question: Three years ago, the average age of a husband, wife, and child was 26 years, and that of the wife and the child, 5 years ago, was 20 years. The present age of the husband is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Present average of **Husband, Wife, and Child** = 26 + 3 = 29 years

Present total age of **Husband, Wife, and Child** = 29 × 3 = 87 years

Present average of **Wife and Child** = 20 + 5 = 25 years

Present total age of **Wife and Child** = 25 × 2 = 50 years

Present age of **Husband** = 87 − 50 = 37 years

**∴ The correct answer is 37 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of **Husband (H)**, **Wife (W)**, and **Child (C)** 3 years ago = 26 years

Average age of **Wife (W)** and **Child (C)** 5 years ago = 20 years

**Formula:** Total Age = Average Age × Number of Persons

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c53157d614118d0ddb17caf4d72c598fd54b7d51cd932ff892645fc8d02e0101.png] 
⇒ Total age of (H + W + C) 3 years ago = 26 × 3 = 78 years
⇒ Present total age of (H + W + C) = 78 + (3 persons × 3 years) = 78 + 9 = 87 years
⇒ Total age of (W + C) 5 years ago = 20 × 2 = 40 years
⇒ Present total age of (W + C) = 40 + (2 persons × 5 years) = 40 + 10 = 50 years
⇒ Present age of **Husband** = (Present total of H, W, C) − (Present total of W, C)
⇒ Present age of **Husband** = 87 − 50 = 37 years

**∴ The correct answer is 37 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Effect of Time on Average Age

If the present average age of a group of **n** people is **A**, then after **k** years, their average age will be **A + k**, and **k** years ago, it was **A − k**.

Sum of Ages

The total sum of ages of **n** people increases by **n × k** after **k** years, as each individual's age increases by **k**.

Finding Age of a New Member

Age of new member = (New Average × New Strength) − (Old Average × Old Strength).</p

questions.question: A train of length 350 m crosses a bridge of length 250 m in 20 seconds. What is the speed of the train (in km/h)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of train = 350 m

Length of bridge = 250 m

Train crosses the bridge in 20 sec

**Formula:**

Speed = Distance/Time

1 km/hr. = 5/18 m/sec

**Calculation:**

Let speed of train be x km/hr, then

x × (5/18) = (350 + 250)/20

⇒ x = 30 × (18/5)

⇒ x = 108 km/hr.

∴ Speed of train is 108 km/hr.
